ledger.claim: The trip was terminated by the DRIVER at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, not by the rider. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and its limb (d) is satisfied only where the record shows termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; the clause states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fourth condition therefore fails on the face of the trip record and the SGD 4.50 charge cannot stand under the anchor clause.

Even taken at its best for the driver, the geometry points to the rider's outcome: the driver's own trace puts him inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius for a single continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds, beginning at 21:23:45 - the exact timestamp of his 'I'm Here' tap - with his closest fix 0.11 m from the pickup pin. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius and he nonetheless cancels under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, and the mis-selected reason code is recorded as a driver-education referral.

The rider did coordinate, and the driver did not answer. The chat log shows the driver's message 'cannot find you, where are you' at 21:24:15 and the rider's reply 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45 - a locating message that names the rider's own position, sent inside the waiting window. The driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and no reply at all before terminating the trip 143 seconds later at 21:27:08, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed either. POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are both made out on this record.

The rider's own device track satisfies POL-NS-04 limb (c). Across the waiting window the rider track carries 43 qualifying fixes running from 21:21:35 to 21:27:51, and every one of them falls inside the STANDARD 100 m rider-presence radius of the pickup pin - maximum distance 17.74 m, mean 13.80 m, minimum 10.14 m - with the rider stationary throughout (the only distinct speed in the track is 0.0 km/h). The rider was at the pickup point for the whole of the wait; the rider was not absent from it.

With limb (a) (a locating message from the rider), limb (b) (no driver reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call) and limb (c) (the rider within the presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes) all satisfied, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider: the cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable. This is an independent route to the same outcome as POL-NS-01 limb (d), and it does not depend on the driver's reason code at all.

The sum to be returned is the whole contested amount, SGD 4.50. The fare ledger records total_charged 4.50, a single cancellation_fee line of 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The trip never started - there is no distance fare, time fare, waiting-time fee, booking fee, ERP or surcharge on the ledger - so the only money in issue is the cancellation fee, and on a FULL_REFUND of the filing party's claim the rider is returned the full 4.50 and no part of the charge is left standing.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays the driver at 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, or where POL-NS-10(g) applies. Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE code, and the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome under POL-NS-01 is expressly one of full refund with no driver compensation, so neither condition for a payout is met and the SGD 3.60 figure carried in the ledger's money block is not payable.

Nothing on this record engages POL-NS-09, so the fee should be refunded to the rider rather than held. The artifacts bearing on arrival, dwell and rider presence agree with each other - the driver's trace holds him in the geofence for the same 200 second run in which the rider's track keeps the rider within 17.7 m of the pin - so there is no two-artifact contradiction of the kind a reviewer would have to settle; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test does not trip, because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 over driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008 (below 0.08).

No artifact carrying the rider's case is impaired, so no POL-NS-08 discount or POL-GEN-02 confidence cap touches this dispute. The GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 - 100 percent coverage, 10 second sample interval against a 10 second expected interval, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, with both the driver and rider tracks present and 21 of the driver's fixes qualifying; the chat log is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with intact message sequence numbering and read receipts, and its two messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 2; and the fare breakdown is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with its 4.50 cancellation line reconciling exactly to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The traffic advisory is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, and I cite it only for its absence: no advisory covers Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 in this window. That absence is itself the point - there is no recorded kerb restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident at this pickup road that could have prevented the driver from holding position or from moving the short distance to the lift lobby the rider named, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory of an admissible type before any conduct on the driver's side can be excused by one. The artifact is disclosed as MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is relied on for nothing but that absence.

The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 200 seconds — 21 consecutive in-radius fixes running from 21:23:45 to 21:27:05 — which discharges POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (c): there is a driver 'arrived' event at 21:23:45, the trace places him inside the geofence at that timestamp, and he held position for longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and not the pre-version-2 minimum_dwell_sec).

The waiting-period arithmetic closes in the driver's favour: the effective in-geofence dwell of 200 seconds exceeds the 180-second free waiting period by 20 seconds, so there is no shortfall and POL-NS-06's premature-cancellation refund is not licensed on this record. The accumulation limb POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable in any event — EV-ADVIS-02724-01 is MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload), so there is no advisory covering the pickup road — and the driver does not rely on it; its absence is evidence neither for nor against him.

The 'arrived' marker is not a false one. The derived arrival returns dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0, meaning the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at the timestamp of the driver's arrival event itself; the driver was therefore not still 300 m out and not travelling at or above 15 km/h when he tapped 'I'm Here', so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral attaches to him.

Nothing in the driver's profile engages POL-NS-07's anti-farming gate: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is a rate of 0.008, far below the 0.08 the clause also requires (the test needs both limbs). Compensation may not be withheld on profile grounds, and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter on the same profile is not the field POL-NS-07 reads and may not be substituted for it.

ledger.claim: No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present on this record: every artifact that carries the arrival, dwell or rider-presence facts is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival, dwell or presence, the parties have no no-show dispute history between them (disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles) and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The case is therefore decidable on its merits and should not be held.

If the fee is held chargeable, the driver's entitlement is the net figure POL-NS-07 fixes — 80 per cent of the $4.50 cancellation fee, that is $3.60 — which is the very figure the fare ledger's own money block computes under POL-NS-07, and on such a ruling the emitted value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring the driver payment and the rider's charge standing as the disposition of the fee.

The driver does not press the fee on the footing that this was a rider no-show, and does not stretch the record to do so: the cancellation is recorded under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which POL-NS-01 limb (d) states in terms does not satisfy that limb, and the rider's own device also places her stationary within roughly 14 m of the pin through the waiting window. The concession is confined to that limb — the driver asks only that the record show his arrival, his full 200-second wait and his clean 30-day no-show record, and that the adverse entry be the single driver-education referral the clause provides for a mis-selected reason code, with no false-arrival or fee-farming finding added to it.

ruling.explanation:
This dispute concerns the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged to the rider after the driver cancelled trip TRP-02724 at 21:27:08 under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The rider is refunded the whole SGD 4.50, and no driver compensation is payable.

Driver — most of your account is accepted. Your GPS trace (EV-GPS-02724, weight 1.0) places you inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 21:23:45, the timestamp of your 'I'm Here' tap, and holds you there for a continuous run of 21 qualifying fixes lasting 200 seconds — longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02724). Your arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides with the arrival event (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the waiting clock and no false-arrival referral attaches. Your profile also raises no anti-farming bar (no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 POL-NS-07 requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 also required — both limbs must hold). But none of that decides the fee. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (d) requires termination for RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE — as you acknowledge — is none of them; the clause names it as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider. Because your stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome: the fee is not chargeable, the rider is refunded in full, and no compensation is payable. Your claim for the SGD 3.60 net figure under POL-NS-07 therefore fails: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full or POL-NS-10(g) applies, and neither condition holds. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags field on your profile was correctly not used for anything — it is not the field POL-NS-07 reads.

Rider — you also succeed independently under POL-NS-04. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02724, weight 1.0) shows your locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 21:24:45 inside the waiting window; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before cancelling 143 seconds later; and your own device track (EV-GPS-02724) was within the 100 m rider-presence radius for all 43 qualifying fixes, maximum 17.74 m from the pin. POL-NS-04 likewise refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.

Amount: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02724, weight 1.0) records total_charged 4.50, a single cancellation_fee line of 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The trip never started — no distance fare, time fare, waiting-time fee, booking fee, ERP or surcharge — so the whole contested amount is the cancellation fee, and SGD 4.50 is returned to the rider. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this refund executes automatically on issue.

The traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02724-01) is MISSING and carries weight 0.0; it was cited by both sides only for its absence. It cannot carry any fact, but its absence is itself citable, and POL-NS-06(i) — which requires a present and populated advisory of an admissible type — is not available to excuse or extend anything here, and nothing rested on it. No artifact deciding this case is impaired: the GPS trace, trip record, chat log and fare breakdown are all COMPLETE at weight 1.0, with 100 percent trace coverage, no gaps, intact chat sequence numbering and a cancellation line reconciling to the figure in force, so no POL-NS-08 discount and no POL-GEN-02 confidence cap below 1.0 applies. No contradiction between admissible artifacts, no disputes-with-counterparty history and no anti-farming trip on either profile engages POL-NS-09, so the case is decided rather than held.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-01: driver-education item — the trip was terminated under the mis-selected reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE while the driver's stationary fixes lay inside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius; record the mis-selected reason code against driver DRV-09724 for driver education.
